title: Binance Futures Will List Coin-Margined Quarterly 0630 Futures Contracts
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will list  BTC, ETH, BNB, ADA, LINK, BCH, XRP, DOT, and LTC Coin-Margined Quarterly 0630 Contracts  within a few hours after Coin-Margined Quarterly 1230 Contracts expire and settle at  2022-12-30 08:00 (UTC).  Notes: Users are only allowed to close their positions or place Reduce Only orders and are not allowed to open any new positions ten minutes prior to delivery. For further information, please refer to  Delivery and Settlement of Quarterly Futures .  Thanks for your support!
